policies.title: Cancellation and refunds
policies.answer: Cancellations are free more than 24 hours before pickup. Within 24 hours, a 50% cancellation fee applies. A no-show is non-refundable.

policies.title: Security deposit timeline
policies.answer: The demo security deposit is released after the vehicle inspection. Allow 5–7 business days for it to appear in your original payment account.

policies.title: Insurance and damage
policies.answer: The ₹249 demo insurance option covers eligible accidental damage, subject to the rental agreement and excess. Personal belongings, negligence and unauthorised drivers are excluded. Contact support to review a specific incident.

policies.title: Fuel and late returns
policies.answer: Return the vehicle with the same fuel level as pickup. If you expect to be late, contact support before your return time to arrange an extension and confirm any additional charge.

policies.title: Payment failed
policies.answer: Check your payment details and try again. If your bank shows a debit without a confirmed booking, contact support with the transaction reference before retrying.

policies.title: Pickup checklist
policies.answer: Bring your valid driving licence and photo ID. Check the vehicle with the pickup team, document any existing damage, and confirm the fuel level before starting your trip.
